objective: Mine a daily timing factor for CSI300 vs CSI1000 style spread on A-share broad-base ETFs, with TVT discipline 2018-2022 / 2022-2023 / 2024-now and 5 mandatory audits.

mechanism_candidates.name: M1_volatility_regime
mechanism_candidates.why: Realized vol spike on small-cap relative to large-cap → risk-off → CSI300 outperforms over ~5d. A-share retail-driven small-caps amplify panic-vol asymmetry.
supporting_evidence: A-share volatility cluster regimes 2018Q4, 2020Q1, 2024Q1 — historical pattern
vol-targeting / risk-parity literature on rebalance-driven equity rotation
caveats: vol-spread can become collinear with 20d momentum during trending regimes
vol regimes cluster in time → audit 4 best-year-out exposure

mechanism_candidates.name: M2_turnover_divergence
mechanism_candidates.why: Small-cap turnover spike vs large-cap → retail euphoria → ~5d mean-reversion → favour 300.
supporting_evidence: A-share retail turnover share consistently above developed markets
caveats: correlated with M1 vol-spread; may be a noisier proxy

mechanism_candidates.name: M3_dispersion_proxy
mechanism_candidates.why: High small-cap basket dispersion → idiosyncratic noise dominates ETF return → favour broad-index 300 until dispersion contracts.
supporting_evidence: cross-sectional dispersion as stock-picking premium proxy
caveats: index high-low only weakly proxies true cross-sectional dispersion without constituent data

mechanism_candidates.name: M4_spread_momentum_reversal
supporting_evidence: short-term reversal in style spreads documented in cross-asset literature

mechanism_candidates.name: M5_market_regime_defensive
mechanism_candidates.why: Bear → favour 300, bull → favour 1000 via 60-120d trailing return signal.
caveats: pure trend-follow → overfits to specific bear/bull episodes; likely fails worst-year audit
